relationship_to_source_availability: fresh outcomes and official pages already existed; this is not a pristine prospective preregistration
ticket_policy: one ticket per race and bet type maximizing model event probability minus closing-win-q proxy event probability
tie_break: higher model event probability, then ascending numeric horse-number tuple
market_comparator: ticket with the highest closing-win-q proxy event probability
probability_extension: Plackett-Luce ordered probabilities; sums over permutations for unordered bets; Harville top-k containment for place/wide
settlement: official KRA final winning-combination dividend; losing selected ticket gross return 0; one-unit stake
fee_treatment: official final dividend already reflects takeout, so 20%/27% is not subtracted again
not_available: direct complex-bet market EDGE or EV
Kelly sizing inputs for complex bets
interpretation: descriptive fresh settlement only, not an executable strategy or deployment confirmation
